rv.q: The play is creepy and gory in all the right ways.
The result is a chilling children’s fairy tale made for adults that takes you on an adventure through the liminal spaces between dream and waking.
The combination created an unexpectedly funny, entertaining and imaginative evening.

Ultimately, this production gives form to the disturbing terrors of the magical world, but audiences can still go home and take comfort in Grandmother’s favorite mortal pleasures: “tea, blankets, and stories.”

cn.t: This dark fairy tale thriller earns praise for its creepy atmosphere and ambitious storytelling, though execution occasionally falters. Critics applaud the gory spectacle and creative premise about sisters battling an evil faerie queen.
